episode.title: A History of Hinduism

chapters.title: Intro: Not a Name, But a River

episode.tagline: Hinduism contains multitudes -- and is contained by multitudes. Any simple story you tell about it is bound to be false.
episode.about: In this episode, Amit and Ajay put together a potted history of Hinduism that goes beyond simple narratives and acknowledges its complexity. They also try to make sense of the historical circumstances and incentives that shaped it.
